description: This file implements an OAuth browser flow for authentication, including starting a local server to handle OAuth redirects, opening a browser for user authorization, and processing the callback to retrieve authorization codes.

classes.name: McpOAuthBrowserFlow
classes.description: Class managing OAuth authorization flow via browser, including local server handling and callback processing.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Initiates the OAuth authorization process, attempting to use a local server and falling back if necessary.

methods.name: authorizeWithLocalServer
methods.description: Sets up a local HTTP server to handle OAuth redirect callback, opens the authorization URL in a browser, and resolves with authorization code and redirect URI.
